scheme_name: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Skill Development to MSME Sector
other_conditions: The applicant unit must belong to the MSME sector.
The MSME must sponsor a candidate from its own workforce.
The candidate must have at least one year of experience in the MSME.
The training partner/organization must have at least 10 years of experience.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹10,000 per trainee as 100% course‑fee reimbursement, plus additional support such as transport reimbursement and up to ₹1,00,000 per training centre for awareness programmes.
